sis_options_desc: Switch between keyboard/mouse and gamepad without restarting, in both online and offline play.
sis_mode_desc: Automatic uses the most recently active device. Forced modes lock camera/input semantics but do not destroy either physical route.
sis_axis_threshold_desc: How far an analog stick must move before the game changes to gamepad mode. Increase this if stick drift causes unwanted switches.
sis_axis_change_threshold_desc: How much an already displaced stick must change before it counts as new gamepad activity. Increase this to ignore drift jitter without changing the gameplay deadzones.
sis_prompt_style_desc: Choose fixed PC labels, stock A/X/B/Y glyphs, or CIRCLE/CROSS/TRIANGLE/SQUARE text labels. This never changes the public controller type or the stable menu code path.
sis_gamepad_look_sensitivity_desc: Right-stick camera speed multiplier. 1.00 keeps the base-game speed; the mod defaults to 2.00.
sis_gamepad_ads_sensitivity_desc: An additional multiplier used only while aiming down sights. 1.00 preserves the same proportion as hip-fire look.
sis_gamepad_look_deadzone_desc: Ignore small right-stick movement. Increase this if the camera drifts, or lower it for a more immediate response.
sis_gamepad_invert_y_desc: Off: pushing the stick up looks up. On: use inverted flight-style vertical look.
sis_force_aim_assist_desc: Enable the mod-managed ADS snap and sticky aim independently of the selected prompt style. ADS snap also applies to keyboard and mouse.
sis_aim_assist_menu_desc: Tune the two safe vanilla aim-assist phases. These options do not alter weapon target cones, damage, recoil, or network data.
sis_aim_assist_sticky_enabled_desc: Continuously assists right-stick tracking while Always-on aim assist is enabled.
sis_aim_assist_sticky_strength_desc: Multiplier for the vanilla sticky correction speed. 1.00 is stock strength; this does not enlarge the target-acquisition cone.
sis_aim_assist_snap_enabled_desc: Attract the camera to a valid target when entering aim-down-sights while Always-on aim assist is enabled.
sis_aim_assist_snap_strength_desc: Multiplier for how quickly the vanilla ADS attraction completes. 1.00 is stock strength.
sis_controller_tuning_desc: Additional radial deadzone and response controls. Defaults preserve the PAYDAY 2 response outside the existing right-stick deadzone.
sis_gamepad_move_deadzone_desc: Ignore movement near the center of the left stick. 0.10 matches PAYDAY 2's built-in movement cutoff; increase it only to remove drift.
sis_gamepad_move_outer_deadzone_desc: Reach full movement before the physical edge. 0.00 is stock; 0.10 reaches full input at roughly 90% travel.
sis_gamepad_move_response_curve_desc: 1.00 preserves the linear response after the deadzone. Lower values react faster near center; higher values give finer low-speed control.
sis_gamepad_look_outer_deadzone_desc: Reach maximum camera input before the physical edge. 0.00 is stock; increase it if the stick cannot reach full travel.
sis_gamepad_look_response_curve_desc: 1.00 preserves the stock radial response. Lower values turn faster near center; higher values improve fine aiming near center.
sis_menu_mouse_desc: Keep physical mouse support available even when the menu was opened with a gamepad.
sis_gamepad_bindings_desc: Use the current PAYDAY 2 controller layout or create a local gameplay profile for XInput/Steam Input pads. Menu controls remain fixed so the menu cannot be locked accidentally.
sis_custom_gamepad_bindings_desc: Off uses the game's live vanilla controller setup. On replaces the listed gameplay actions with this profile. Duplicate buttons intentionally trigger every action assigned to them.
sis_binding_common_desc: Choose a gamepad button for this gameplay action. Applied after leaving this menu.
sis_bind_use_item_desc: Vanilla: hold to deploy; tap to switch between the primary and secondary deployable when the skill is available.
sis_bind_weapon_gadget_desc: Vanilla: tap for the weapon gadget; hold to deploy a supported bipod.
sis_restore_vanilla_bindings_desc: Restore the current PAYDAY 2 default layout and disable the custom profile.
